title: Reunion with Old Acquaintances
next_chapter_hook: As forces from all sides reached the breaking point, a familiar figure that made hearts ache suddenly appeared before everyone—Chen Nian, missing for years, carrying the last heirloom from the Chen family ancestral land, stepping into this life-or-death chess game.

text.content: The illusion dissolved like rippling water, yet Su Qingyao's penetrating gaze that cut through all barriers continued to sear Chen Ji's heart. He understood that every glance from her pushed him closer to the abyss—her intuition was terrifying. Before he could process this, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, its ink writhing to form new characters: 'Old acquaintances approach, life and death hang in balance.' Before he could decipher this omen, two distinctly different auras ripped through the sky—one cold as abyssal spring, the other as imposing as a mountain pressing down.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's figure stepped out from a tear in the Void, demonic mists swirling around her like a tide. Her face had grown paler since their last meeting, the Holy Sect's mark on her brow becoming even more ferocious. 'Chen Ji, I've arrived just in time, haven't I?' Her voice carried a hoarse edge, yet in her hand she had already unfurled a blood-glowing silk scroll. 'The roster of Black Xuanwu—all twenty-seven names are here. Over half are high-ranking officials from the three great sects, and their true purpose—' She paused, terror flickering in her eyes. 'They intend to use the Tianji Record Fragment within you as a sacrifice for the awakening will of the old Heavenly Path!'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart plummeted. The will of the old Heavenly Path—fragments he had only occasionally caught from Mo Xiansheng's residual soul, a supreme terror he believed still far from his reach. Yet Ye Qing's intelligence was too detailed; every name corresponded to concrete evidence, every clue pointing to the same horrifying truth: the so-called Black Xuanwu were merely chess pieces placed by the old Heavenly Path in the mortal world, and he himself, utterly unaware, had become the most crucial piece on the board.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji.' An elderly yet commanding voice rang out from another direction. Ling Yuan's figure materialized like a specter in mid-air. Clad in the Tianqing Sect Master's玄青 ceremonial robe, his benevolent features bordered on false, but his eyes concealed something more terrifying than any abyss. 'The Tianji Record in your hands was abandoned by the Heavenly Path from the start. Now that it has attracted the covetous attention of so many forces, why should the common folk pay the price for your existence?' He lightly raised his hand, and an ancient scroll materialized from thin air. 'The Dimension Guardians' Alliance offers you a deal—surrender the Tianji Record in exchange for peace across the Three Realms. You will remain a disciple of the Tianqing Sect, and may still live the life you desire.'

Chen Ji gazed at Ling Yuan's benevolent face, yet icy mockery churned in his heart. This 'compassionate' old sect master was precisely the one rejected by the Tianji Record all those years ago—his hatred concealed for an entire three generations of disciples, now cloaked in the guise of protecting all creation. He couldn't be bothered to expose the truth, merely remarking coolly: 'Sect Master Ling, your rhetoric is rather perfunctory. The Tianji Record recognizes its master; it is not something you can simply claim whenever you wish.' His tone was calm, yet beneath that calmness lurked a chilling mockery. 'As for you—the 'guardians' of the Dimension Guardians' Alliance, shouldn't the word 'guardians' be put in quotation marks?'

text.content: A barely perceptible killing intent flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes, quickly masked by deeper hypocrisy. Just as he was about to speak, the Tianji Record trembled once more, new characters emerging: 'Secret communications, three zhang to the left, Xuanwu aura.' Chen Ji's peripheral vision swept toward that direction—Han Lie was emerging from behind a massive boulder. His expression was incomprehensibly complex, his former arrogance and disdain replaced by something far heavier. He said nothing, merely gesturing to Chen Ji with an extremely covert sign: three fingers, pointing to the ground, then to his own heart.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's voice was pressed to an extreme whisper, audible only to Chen Ji: 'The remnants of the old Heavenly Path are more insane than I imagined. Their plan has already begun—not just targeting you, but dragging the entire Three Realms into a cycle of rebirth.' His fists clenched, knuckles whitening. 'I know you hate me, hate the Xuanwu Sect. But at times like this, I, Han Lie, still know priorities.' He handed over an unremarkable jade slip. 'This is a communication token I risked my life to intercept. Their final strategy is contained within. You...' His voice suddenly choked. 'Be careful of that woman, Su Qingyao. She is not as simple as you think.'

text.content: Three forces, triple pressure, three entirely different paths. Ye Qing's roster showed him he was merely a sacrificial offering. Ling Yuan's deal concealed ambitions to seize treasure. Han Lie's intelligence hinted at a greater catastrophe approaching. And Su Qingyao... Chen Ji recalled her eyes that saw through everything, an inexplicable exhaustion surging in his heart. He was no god—he was merely an unlucky fool chosen by the Tianji Record, every glimpse of the future demanding the price of Heavenly Fate, every stratagem inviting fatal retaliation from destiny. Yet he could not retreat, for Chen Nian still waited for him somewhere dark and hopeless.

choice.prompt: Facing the pressure from three forces, Chen Ji must make a critical choice:

choices.description: Pretend to negotiate with Ling Yuan, leveraging the Dimension Guardians' Alliance resources to secretly strategize, while obtaining detailed intelligence about the old Heavenly Path remnants from Han Lie. Lowest risk, but may fall into passivity.
choices.visible_cost: Risk exposing secret communications with Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Dimension Guardians' Alliance's trust and intelligence channels
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is crafty and experienced, likely has backup plans

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly inclined his head toward Ling Yuan, revealing a perfectly measured hesitation: 'Sect Master Ling's proposal... allow me to consider it for a few days.' His tone carried a hint of weakness, precisely the 'waste' persona he had carefully maintained for years. A satisfied gleam flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes, as if he could already see the future where the Tianji Record fell into his hands. Yet he did not know that Chen Ji had already clearly noted this debt in his heart—after disposing of the old Heavenly Path remnants, it would be his turn next.

text.content: Ye Qing watched from the sidelines, her gaze flickering slightly. She knew Chen Ji too well—the more weak and easily bullied he appeared, the more dangerous he became. Han Lie's expression was far more complex; he seemed to want to say something, yet ultimately simply retracted his hand in silence. The three forces, each harboring ulterior motives, temporarily formed a bizarre equilibrium. And this was precisely what Chen Ji desired.

choices.description: Tear apart the facade on the spot, use the Tianji Record's power to immediately expose Ling Yuan's true nature, while publicly releasing Han Lie's intelligence, completely shattering the schemes of all parties. Greatest reward, but highest risk.
choices.visible_cost: Completely offend the Dimension Guardians' Alliance, possibly triggering encirclement and attack
choices.visible_reward: Break the deadlock, seize the initiative, force everyone to reassess your strength
choices.risk_hint: Make enemies on three fronts, with enormous Heavenly Fate consumption

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned sharp; he no longer concealed anything. The Tianji Record Fragment materialized in his palm, emanating blinding golden light. 'Sect Master Ling, your performance has gone on long enough.' His voice was cold as glacial ice. 'Dimension Guardians' Alliance? Hmph, you are merely a collection of resentments from the discarded remnants of the old Heavenly Path. The Tianji Record chose me, not you—how many years have you harbored this grievance?' As his words fell, the golden light revealed Ling Yuan's twisted countenance from when he was rejected by the Tianji Record, along with each and every scheme he had secretly plotted thereafter.

text.content: Ling Yuan's complexion instantly turned ashen; the benevolent mask finally shattered, revealing the狰狞 and madness beneath. 'You—!' His voice尖锐得近乎嘶吼, 'Do you think a废物 like you can oppose the entire Dimension Guardians' Alliance?' Ye Qing and Han Lie both retreated a step simultaneously; their gazes toward Chen Ji had completely changed—this man was never any废物, he was a wolf in sheep's clothing, a dormant god of slaughter who had endured for far too long.

choices.description: Combining Ye Qing's list, Han Lie's intelligence, and Ling Yuan's deal skillfully to create chaos where multiple parties suspect each other, allowing Chen Ji to profit from their conflict. Most fitting Chen Ji's style—using others' strength to strike back, gaining maximum benefit with minimum expenditure.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise control of all parties' psychology; one misstep and the entire game is lost.
choices.visible_reward: Three forces check and balance each other, buying precious time for Chen Ji's positioning.
choices.risk_hint: Extremely tests strategic thinking, and could be exposed by any party.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, with a gentleness that bordered on compassion. "Sect Master Ling, I've noted your deal. Ye Qing, I've received your list." He turned to Han Lie, "As for the news you brought—" he lowered his voice, audible only to Han Lie, "Tell those remnants of the Old Heavenly Dao that their opponent is far more terrifying than they could imagine." With that, he cleverly wove together information from all three parties, casting out a bait that would spark mutual suspicion: "The true mastermind behind Black Xuanwu is actually among your three factions."

text.content: This sentence was like a stone dropped into a calm lake, stirring up waves upon waves. The gazes of Ling Yuan, Ye Qing, and Han Lie changed simultaneously—they were suspicious of each other, while also re-evaluating Chen Ji. This man had been controlling the rhythm from start to finish, and they were merely chess pieces being manipulated on the board. A meaningful smile curled at the corner of Ye Qing's lips, Han Lie showed an expression of "as expected", and Ling Yuan... a flash of wariness crossed his eyes, immediately replaced by deeper, darker intentions.

choices.memory_label: 反向利用三方势力制衡

text.content: Three distinctly different auras clashed in the air, yet Chen Ji felt an odd calm within this tense atmosphere. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said: "The ultimate realm of a chess player isn't to capture all the pieces, but to make each side believe they are the one holding the reins." At this moment, he was the hidden Chess Player behind the scenes. Ye Qing brought a blade, Ling Yuan offered a rope, and Han Lie presented fire seeds—and he merely needed to place these three things in the correct positions to ignite a prairie fire that would burn away all schemes.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly stepped forward, demonic path mist quietly spreading, subtly isolating Ling Yuan's presence. "Chen Ji, whatever choice you make, I stand with you." Her voice was soft, yet carried unwavering resolve. "The Holy Sect used me as a tool for so many years. You showed me what it truly means to live." Her gaze upon Chen Ji held a tenderness she had never revealed before. "This time, I won't let you bear this alone."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened sharply. Ye Qing's words pierced his defenses more than any blade could. He knew this woman, raised as a chess piece by the Holy Sect, had placed too much trust in him—trust she shouldn't have. He wasn't worth it—he was a wretch who couldn't even protect his sister, a pitiful creature who paid with his life every time he foresaw the future. Yet looking at the determination in her eyes, he suddenly couldn't refuse. Perhaps this was what they called a bond. He sighed softly: "Silly girl, do you know you'll die like this?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's cold voice abruptly sounded at this moment, breaking the brief warmth: "What a touching scene. Unfortunately—" his tone suddenly turned sinister, "The Dimensional Guardian Alliance has grown tired of waiting. Chen Ji, I ask you one final time, hand it over or not?" Before the words even finished, dozens of powerfully auraed figures emerged in the Void, surrounding the area completely. These were the core combat forces of the Dimensional Guardian Alliance, each a powerhouse capable of shaking an entire region. They arrived faster than anticipated—clearly, Ling Yuan had never intended to give Chen Ji a choice from the start.

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze finally turned completely cold. He slowly raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment unfolding gently in his palm, and those fragmented characters unexpectedly emitted a blinding light at this moment. "Ling Yuan, do you really think numbers can overwhelm me?" His voice was soft, yet carried an unsettling certainty. "Every foresight of the Tianji Record consumes Heavenly Fate. But do you know—" a mocking arc curved at the corner of his mouth, "When Heavenly Fate reaches zero, the future I see will make even the Heavenly Dao tremble."

choice.prompt: Facing Ling Yuan's pressing步步紧逼, Chen Ji needed to make the final choice:

choices.description: Burning all Heavenly Fate without hesitation, awakening the ultimate foresight ability of the Tianji Record, directly viewing the future that would make even the Heavenly Dao tremble. A decisive blow to determine victory or defeat, but the cost might be immediate exhaustion and death.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate reaches zero, significant loss of life force
choices.visible_reward: Exposing Ling Yuan's deepest secret on the spot, destroying his reputation completely
choices.risk_hint: Extremely dangerous, may fall on the spot

dialogue.content: Determination flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly ignited, and within the golden light appeared scenes he had never witnessed—a vision of Ling Yuan kneeling before an ancient altar, selling his soul to a twisted shadow. And that shadow's aura was identical to the evil presence that appeared the night Chen Nian disappeared. "So that's how it is." Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold and biting, "You were the one who schemed against the Chen family back then."

text.content: Ling Yuan's face instantly turned as pale as paper, his voice sharp and近乎疯狂: "Impossible! How could that secret possibly—" his words stopped abruptly, because the golden light had already projected his image before everyone. His betrayal, his schemes, everything he did to Chen Nian—all were exposed without hiding. Ye Qing冷笑一声, Han Lie wore an expression of "no wonder", and those powerful figures from the Dimensional Guardian Alliance... their gaze toward Ling Yuan had shifted from reverence to deep vigilance and hostility.

choices.memory_label: 燃烧天命揭露凌渊真相

choices.text: Let Ye Qing cover the retreat
choices.description: Using Ye Qing's demonic path mist to cover the retreat, preserving strength while waiting for a better opportunity. Though somewhat humiliating, only by surviving can there be a chance for a comeback.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing will bear all the pressure from pursuers, may suffer serious injuries or be captured
choices.visible_reward: Preserving oneself and intelligence, leaving the spark for a future counterattack
choices.risk_hint: Risking the loss of this important ally

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, making the hardest decision of his life: "Ye Qing, cover for me." He didn't look back, because he dared not meet her eyes. He knew what this meant—letting a woman risk her life to cover his retreat was not Chen Ji's style. But Ye Qing merely smiled faintly, her expression carrying a mixture of relief and resolve. "Go, Chen Ji. I'll wait for you to come back for me."

text.content: The Demonic Path mist surged forth like a tide, shrouding the entire area in impenetrable darkness. Chen Ji felt Ye Qing's hand gently push him, and then her presence vanished into the depths of the mist. He ran, carrying intelligence and name-lists of everyone, carrying Ye Qing's sacrifice and expectations, carrying deep-seated hatred for Ling Yuan and boundless longing for Chen Nian. He would return, he swore—he would come back with power enough to destroy everything, to rescue Ye Qing intact and unharmed.

choices.memory_label: 忍痛撤退，留下夜清断后

choices.text: Allied with Han Lie to counterattack
choices.description: Accept Han Lie's proposal and join forces to counterattack. Han Lie's Combat Power combined with Chen Ji's strategic cunning was enough to carve a bloody path through this chaotic battlefield.
choices.visible_cost: Being heavily indebted to Han Lie, and the Xuanwu Sect's stance will completely shift in Chen Ji's favor
choices.visible_reward: The combined Combat Power is sufficient to directly contend with the Dimensional Guardians Alliance, and can obtain full support from the Xuanwu Sect
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's mind is unpredictable; he may have ulterior motives

dialogue.content: Han Lie let out a thunderous laugh, his twin fists crashing outward. The Xuanwu True Intent manifested into a roaring giant turtle and a surging giant serpent, projecting terrifying visions behind him. "Chen Ji, in all my life, I've never looked up to many people—but you're one of them!" His voice shook the heavens. "Today, you and I joining forces will show these rats hiding in the shadows what true genius looks like!"

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely perfectly merging the power of the Tianji Record with Han Lie's Xuanwu True Intent. His Foresight Ability pointed out every enemy weakness for Han Lie, while Han Lie's brute strength blasted a bloody path for their escape route. The two—one literary, one martial, one strategist, one warrior—coordinated with默契 that surpassed even longtime friends. Ye Qing watched from afar, her gaze complicated—she knew that from this moment on, the position by Chen Ji's side would no longer be hers alone.

At this critical moment, the ink on the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently, and a line of text mysteriously appeared: 'She has arrived.' Chen Ji's heart shuddered—he knew without doubt that this 'she' could be no one but Chen Nian. But how could she appear here? The Tianji Record clearly showed that any foresight involving her was blurred; he couldn't capture any information about her at all. Just as doubts flooded his mind, a voice achingly familiar cut through the battlefield's edge: "Brother, I'm back."

dialogue.content: Chen Nian stood on the cliff not far away, her robes fluttering gracefully, as if she had never left. But Chen Ji saw something terribly wrong at a glance—her aura was too calm, almost eerie in its tranquility, as if all emotions had been stripped away by some force. And the object cradled in her arms emanated an aura Chen Ji knew intimately—it was the final relic of the Chen Family ancestral land, the divine artifact recorded in the ancestral teachings as capable of 'dispelling the poison of Heavenly Secrets.' He didn't know what Chen Nian had experienced over these years, but in her vacant eyes, he saw something more terrifying than death.

text.content: Chen Ji's body moved forward against his will, an instinctive reaction he had suppressed through countless日夜. Chen Nian—the sister he had searched for so long, schemed for so long, even dared to make enemies of the entire world for, now stood before him, alive and real. But at the same time, a profound fear seized his heart. Her appearance was too sudden, her aura too诡异, the relic in her hands of unknown origin. Was all this coincidence, or part of a larger conspiracy? The Tianji Record fell silent—it was the first time it had refused to guide him at a critical moment.

Ling Yuan's laughter rang out at this moment, carrying a nearly manic得意: "See that, Chen Ji? This is the sister you've been searching for all along." His voice was sinister. "You think how she escaped from the Holy Sect? I let her go. You think where the relic in her hand came from? I gave it to her." His eyes blazed with mad light. "This chess game, from the moment you obtained the Tianji Record, I had already set it up. And you—nothing more than a key for me to usher in a new era!" Ye Qing's face changed dramatically, Han Lie's fists cracked with tension, and Chen Ji... in his eyes remained only Chen Nian's vacant, heartbreaking gaze.

Chen Nian simply stood there quietly, watching Chen Ji. She didn't cry, didn't smile, as if looking at a stranger. Her lips parted slightly, but what emerged sent chills down the spine: "Brother, I'm sorry... I must complete my mission." She slowly raised the relic in her hand, and ancient, sacred light began to surge. Chen Ji felt as though his heart was being crushed by an iron grip—his sister, whom he had searched for so long, was actually the sharpest blade in the enemy's hand. And he, he didn't even have the courage to resist, because what faced him was not an enemy, but his own flesh and blood, his only remaining connection in this world.

Ye Qing could bear it no longer. Her figure transformed into a streak of black light, rushing toward Chen Nian in an attempt to stop the relic's activation. But Chen Nian merely raised her hand gently, and an invisible force sent Ye Qing flying, crashing heavily to the ground. Blood dripped from the corner of Ye Qing's mouth, yet she still struggled to stand: "Chen Ji... don't give up... she's still conscious... I saw struggle in her eyes..." Her voice grew weaker. "She's... waiting for you... waiting for you to awaken her..." Chen Ji stared into his sister's vacant eyes and indeed caught the faintest flicker of波动. That was Chen Nian, that was his sister—she was still alive, trapped in some dark abyss, waiting for him to save her.
